name: Master Tao
heading: The Examiner
lore: Story-battle version of Master Tao, the examiner of the ledger exam. A boss's stamina and a boss's kit - a longer, multi-turn duel. Elite tier: acts three times per turn even alone.

skills.description: Does damage equal to ATK-scaled to one enemy; applies [ignite.stacks] Ignite.
Does Co-Destruction damage equal to ATK-scaled to one enemy.

ultimate.description: Applies [ignite.stacks] Ignite to all enemies; then does damage equal to ATK-scaled to all enemies.

passive.name: Trial by Fire
passive.description:
# Basic effects
- Immune to Stun, Freeze and Attack Seals
- Damage taken from counterattacks 50% 👇
- DEF 10% 👆 per debuff on the enemy team (Max 50%, Uncancellable)
- ATK and damage dealt 5% 👆 per [Ignite] stack on the enemy team (Uncancellable)

# While an enemy named Duke is on the field
- Damage dealt 20% 👆 (Uncancellable)

# Every time this character receives 5 attacks
- ATK and DEF 5% 👆 (Max 10 times, Uncancellable)

# At the start of this character's turn
- Removes 1 random debuff from self

# When this character defeats an enemy
- Heals 35% of max HP (Only once)
